title: Figures 81-82: Tic Tac CFD temperature and Mach number at 900 mph
description: Two color CFD contour plots of the capsule-shaped "Tic Tac" body at 1/6 scale with numeric color legends. Captions read "Figure 81. Tic Tac Temperature at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 900 mph with Supersonic Inlet and Supersonic Outlet" (a hot wake trailing the body, in K) and "Figure 82. Tic Tac Mach Number at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 900 mph with Supersonic Inlet and Supersonic Outlet" (low-speed wake within a supersonic flow field). Attachment II, page 124 of the BAASS report.
